findings.body: When a reply selects the native Copilot harness, `runEmbeddedAttemptWithBackend` dispatches through `runAgentHarnessAttempt` directly to the plugin, bypassing the modified `runEmbeddedAttempt` and its COMPASS projection. Copilot's `createSystemMessageContent` still consumes only `params.extraSystemPrompt`; it never reads `compassContext`. Removing SSP/retrieval from this array therefore silently removes previously available COMPASS context from those replies, including queued runs. Project the context at a shared dispatch boundary or add a budgeted native-harness consumer before removing the old transport, with regression coverage for that path.
findings.title: [P2] Preserve COMPASS context for native plugin harnesses

overall_explanation: The new payload reaches the built-in embedded and CLI projection paths, but native plugin harnesses such as Copilot lose COMPASS context previously carried by extraSystemPrompt. Review was read-only; tests were not run.
